children: Co-Diagnostics announced a collaboration with ReadyGo to evaluate GoCollect blood sample prep with the Co-Dx PCR platform for decentralized Ebola testing.
Partnership to assess ReadyGo’s GoCollect with Co-Dx PCR to enable blood-based molecular testing at point of need.
Initial focus on decentralized Ebola detection and outbreak response to shorten time to result.
Blood compatibility could extend Co-Dx platform beyond swab tests to HIV and hepatitis B/C, expanding market opportunities.
Feasibility work underway; Co-Dx has received ReadyGo materials but compatibility is not yet established.
Company held an in-person press conference and live webcast on Sept. 16, 2026 to discuss the collaboration.
